scope: disposable local PostgreSQL only; no remote Supabase or real Auth
fixture: 36 source-backed provisional nodes; pending human review; stub Auth users

tests.name: P01 migration and initial 36-node public projection match the visibility adapter
P02 anonymous users can read only the public row, with no history, helpers, writes or editor RPC
P03 authenticated membership is required freshly and direct raw writes remain forbidden
P04 private pending draft does not publish; stale generation and reused operations are rejected
P05 two connections serialize edits and reject the actual blocked stale writer
P06 SQL projection matches JS reading for every source and node/claim/relation/date withdrawal
P07 public projection strips private nested text and preserves unknown data only in private history
P08 source withdrawal publication updates atomically and exposes no withdrawn raw records
P09 private restore preserves accumulated withdrawals and never republishes historical raw text
P10 public optional fields reject nested objects, and failed saves do not alter state
P11 revision withdrawals remain effective after save and restore assign new release IDs
P12 committed public head, private history and withdrawal protection survive database restart
P13 implicit arrow aliases and explicit relation identities agree before and after SQL normalization
P14 generated initial import applies to an empty DB and rejects repeat import without changes
P15 generated backup import treats SQL delimiters as data and preserves current withdrawals in the private draft
